hat is ARA Addiction Recovery Agency (what we can reasonably guess or expect)

I was unable to find strong public records showing a large, widely-advertised company under exactly “ARA Addiction Recovery Agency.” I found no well-maintained website or public job-board presence under that name. This may mean one of the following:

They operate under a slightly different legal name or have limited public profile.

They are a small or medium-size provider of addiction recovery / rehab / support services, possibly local or regional.

They rely on small-scale recruitment (word-of-mouth, referrals) rather than formal public adverts or large HR infrastructure.

Given that, I can’t firmly confirm their size or activity — but based on what typical addiction recovery/rehab agencies do, I can project what their recruiting needs likely are.

✅ If ARA Addiction Recovery Agency is operating — Likely Roles They’d Recruit For

Assuming ARA runs addiction-recovery services (rehab, support, detox, counselling, outreach, aftercare), here are the most common roles such agencies need — and where a recruiter could add value:

Role / Position	Why It’s Typically Needed
Support Workers / Recovery Support Staff	To assist clients with daily routines, support plans, crisis response, group support, outreach — basic staffing backbone.
Addiction / Substance Misuse Counsellors / Therapists	Provide specialist counselling, therapy sessions, 1-on-1 support, relapse prevention, mental-health management.
Case Managers / Care Coordinators	Manage clients’ progress, liaise with social services/healthcare, handle assessments, coordinate support plans and aftercare.
Nurses / Healthcare Staff (if medically-supported detox or aftercare)	Medical supervision, health checks, medication management, monitoring withdrawal, liaising with hospitals/GPs.
Administrative Staff / Reception / Office Support	Booking appointments, managing records, compliance paperwork, client communications — essential support functions.
Residential Staff / House Keepers / Welfare Staff (if residential rehab)	For 24/7 care homes or residential rehab, staff to cover nightly shifts, cleaning, welfare, maintenance of house rules.
Outreach Workers / Community Engagement	To provide support in the community, liaise with external agencies, coordinate after-care support, job and housing support for clients.
Management / Service Managers / Compliance Officers	Oversee operations, ensure compliance with healthcare and social-care regulations, manage staff rotas, quality assurance.
Training & Development Staff	To deliver in-house training, CPD, safeguarding courses, mental-health first aid — needed in regulated care settings.
Support Admin (HR, Payroll, Recruitment) (if agency sizeable)	Managing sensitive staff checks (DBS), scheduling, rotas, staff wellbeing, qualifications and compliance tracking.

Because addiction-recovery agencies typically deal with vulnerable clients, regulation, 24/7 care, and often high staff turnover, the staffing demand tends to be constant, across many levels — from frontline support to admin and compliance.

???? How a Recruitment Agency Could Add Value to ARA Addiction Recovery Agency

If ARA is active and needs staff, your agency could add value in several important ways:

Sourcing vetted, experienced care/support workers or counsellors — especially those with mental-health, social care, or addiction-support backgrounds. These are niche, sensitive roles: pre-screening and care-competency checking matters.

Supporting compliance-heavy hiring — ensuring staff have right credentials, DBS checks, references, first aid / safeguarding training, background suitability.

Providing flexible staffing solutions for shift work / 24-hour care: e.g. supplying temporary or on-call staff to fill night-shift gaps, sickness, holidays, demand spikes.

Helping build a stable workforce — reducing reliance on ad-hoc recruitment by providing a talent pipeline, which improves retention and reduces burnout.

Taking administrative burden away — managing screening, compliance checks, references, inductions — important when internal HR is limited.

Quick response for urgent vacancies — allowing them to react swiftly to funding changes, client load increases, or regulatory staffing requirements.

✅ My View: ARA Addiction Recovery Agency — Potentially a Moderate Prospect

Because I can’t verify public records or company size, I’d classify ARA as a “speculative but possible” prospect.

Their sector (addiction recovery / social care) tends to have high staff demand and turnover, which matches well with agency-based staffing needs — especially for care workers, support staff, and compliance-heavy roles.

If they are active, having a recruitment partner who understands the complexity and sensitivity of care staffing can be a real asset.

Conclusion: It’s worth a light outreach — a short message or call offering a compliance-focused staffing solution; if they respond, run a deeper qualification to check their operational status.

Good Morning,
 
I contacted you today as I wanted to see if you need any help with advertising any vacancies for current or upcoming recruitment for 2021.
You may be currently recruiting for positions and we would like to discuss what we could do to compliment and enhance your campaign to
help you find the perfect candidates for the role.
 
For your reference, I’ve included our essential information and pricing on this email.
Should you have interest in our services, feel free to email me and we can arrange for one of our account managers to call you to discuss further.

With regards to our service and how we operate, please find a brief summary below: 

 We are not a traditional recruitment agency who might charge you a percentage of the candidates’ salary once placed. 
 We operate slightly differently, but in doing so, we often save employers £1000’s in fees. 
 
 
Service: 
 
•	We firstly never charge any commission, at all. There are no added costs and you know exactly the costings to your adverts prior to placing them. 
 
•	We have different cost options, depending on your preferred package (see below). Each package offers a slightly different level of exposure. 
 
•	With your adverts, we always optimise/design these in order to make sure your advert not only attracts candidates, but attracts the right type of candidate.
 
•	Optimising Adverts: We compare and advise on the adverts Job Title. We compare and advise on the Salary bracketing offered for the role. This information is crucial in order to attract the best candidates. 
 
•	Your advert is placed on 13+ of the UK’s biggest job boards for 28 days, in your specific location. 
 
•	You receive full access to our Applicant Tracking Software (Portal), in order to view, filter and respond to candidates. 
 
•	Our Applicant Tracking Software makes it much easier to view and respond to candidates, saving you the time normally demanded by recruitment campaigns. 
•	The Portal stores all applications so you can start to build a profile of applicants, should you need. 
•	You can then re-visit the Portal at any time in order to view and contact any applications, regardless of when the application was received. 
 
•	We offer discounts if purchasing adverts in 3+. Purchasing adverts in a credit package will save on the normal cost per advert, and the credits never expire. 
 
•	You will receive one dedicated Account Manager. Your Account Manager will be here to help you with any questions or issues you might have.
 
 
 
Package Options: 
 
Please see below the options for you to consider: 
 
Standard Advert
Job Boards = Reed (sponsored), Total Jobs, Indeed, Jobsite, Job Flurry, Adzuna, Facebook Jobs, Google for Jobs, CareerJet, Find A Job, Zip Recruiter, Trovit, Zoek, Glassdoor, Job Rapido and Twitter. 
 
Premium Advert 
Job Boards = LinkedIn (sponsored), CV Library (sponsored), Reed (sponsored), Total Jobs, Indeed, Jobsite, Job Flurry, Adzuna, Facebook Jobs, Google for Jobs, CareerJet, Find A Job, Zip Recruiter, Trovit, Zoek, Glassdoor, Job Rapido and Twitter.
 
Premium branded Advert
Job Boards = Reed (sponsored), CV Library (sponsored), LinkedIn (sponsored), Total Jobs (sponsored) & Facebook. 
 
This will also include all of the additional non branded job boards; Indeed, Jobsite, Job Flurry, Adzuna, Facebook Jobs, Google for Jobs, CareerJet and Glassdoor.
 
 
Pricing Options: 
 
•	1x Standard Advert = £299 +VAT 
•	3x Standard Advert = £799 +VAT                              / Cost per advert £266 +VAT 
•	5x Standard Advert = £1,199 +VAT                           / Cost per advert £239 +VAT 
•	8x Standard Advert = £1,599 +VAT                           / Cost per advert £199 +VAT 
 
•	1x Premium Advert = £399 +VAT 
•	3x Premium Advert = £1,099 +VAT                          / Cost per advert £366 +VAT 
•	5x Premium Advert = £1,599 +VAT                           / Cost per advert £319 +VAT 
•	 
 
•	1x Branded Premium Advert = £499 +VAT 
•	3x Branded Premium Advert = £1,399 +VAT         / Cost per advert £466 +VAT 
•	5x Branded Premium Advert = £2,099 +VAT         / Cost per advert £419 +VAT 
 
 
 
 
Next Steps: 
 
I would love the opportunity to book you in for a quick call with one of our Account Managers.
The Account Manager will then be able to verbally summarise the above and will happily answer any questions that you might have. 
 
 
All of the information above, and conversated over the phone, is consultation lead and requires no commitment or fee. 
We are really looking to engage you into our process, but if our service is not for you on this occasion, no problem at all. 
 
Look forward to hearing from you!

Hi Emma,
 

Thank you for your time on the phone today, lovely speaking with you.

To recap from our conversation, I feel there is one key way to increase the response you receive when reposting the advert. 


Salary:

Adding a salary to the advert could really make the difference in terms of application numbers and the quality you receive. 

Essentially, candidates who are currently in work within a similar role, who are looking for a new position, will often apply for roles in which they can see the potential earnings. This allows them, with confidence, to apply for a role they have experience within for a salary that offers the same (or better) than what they currently earn. 

These same candidates who come across positions with no salary, often pass up on the opportunity due to the normal length in time an application process takes (telephone interviews, face-to-face interviews etc)… when there is no guarantee that they will earn close to their current salary. 

Naturally, the above is not an exact science, but we do often see an upturn in application numbers from candidates with experience when the salary is shown. 


Showing the salary: 

You do not need to simply list the salary they are receiving; “the successful candidates will earn £25,000”. 

This for obvious reasons could highlight the salary to others within your employment (as suggested on the phone), or, you might feel you have to give the candidate that offered salary (£25,000) regardless of their experience. 

The key way to avoid this is by using a bracketed salary. 

Using a bracketed format gives the candidate confidence that they can earn their expected salary. 

“The successful candidate will earn £20,000 - £25,000 per year depending on their experience”. 

As described, the above gives you the opportunity to offer the candidate the salary you think their experience warrants – whilst not potentially upsetting current employees in a similar role. 




With the above being said, the decision is definitely still yours. 

We often re-post adverts using the exact same wording as previously and find a much better calibre of candidate the next month for no given reason. 

Candidates search the various job boards at different times and for slightly different reasons. 


If you wish to repost your advert, without showing the salary – or any other changes – please do let me know. 


Advert Cost Options: 


-	1x Premium Advert = £399 +VAT 



I look forward to hearing your thoughts on the above and any questions you might have. 


Please do not hesitate to call or email on my contact information below. 


Direct Dial: 01772 737093



Kind Regards,

Machine operating (mixers, fillers, bagging lines, batch plants)

James

James

14.02.22 Called and spoke to Bergit briefly. He advised to e-mail him.

Hi Bergit,

Thank you for taking my call earlier. It was nice speaking to you.

As your account manager going forward, if you were to use us again, I would do a weekly check in, monitor the response and look at ways we can optimise the advert to get the best response possible.

Apologies for the long-winded e-mail but I wanted to cover all your options going forward so you can understand fully what the packages offer.

We offer 3 different advert options to consider, each slightly differs in the level of exposure offered. Standard, Premium or Branded. 


How many positions are you looking to advertise for? 


I have included the 3x and 5x credit package option for you to consider, especially if you have more than 1 position required (either now or in the future). 

Our advert credits never expire so please don’t worry about using these within a time frame – if you do opt to purchase more than 1. 


Standard Advert: 

1x Standard Advert = £299 +VAT 

3x Standard Adverts = £799 +VAT 

5x Standard Adverts = £1,199 +VAT 

Job Boards = Reed (sponsored), Total Jobs (sponsored), Indeed (PPC), Jobsite, Job Flurry, Adzuna, Facebook Jobs, Google for Jobs, CareerJet, Find A Job, Zip Recruiter, Trovit, Zoek, Glassdoor, Job Rapido and Twitter. 


Premium Advert: 

1x Premium Advert = £399 +VAT

3x Premium Adverts = £1,099 +VAT 

5x Premium Adverts = £1,599 +VAT 

Job Boards = LinkedIn (sponsored PPC), CV Library (sponsored), Reed (sponsored), Total Jobs, Indeed (PPC), Jobsite, Job Flurry, Adzuna, Facebook Jobs, Google for Jobs, CareerJet, Find A Job, Zip Recruiter, Trovit, Zoek, Glassdoor, Job Rapido and Twitter.


Branded Advert: 

1x Branded Advert = £499 +VAT 

3x Branded Adverts = £1,399 +VAT

5x Branded Adverts = £2,099 +VAT 

Job Boards including Company Logo and Company Name = Reed (sponsored), CV Library (sponsored), Total Jobs (sponsored) and Jobsite.  

Job Boards including Company name: Indeed (PPC), LinkedIn (Sponsored PPC), Job Flurry, Adzuna, Facebook Jobs, Google for Jobs, CareerJet, Find A Job, Zip Recruiter, Trovit, Zoek, Glassdoor, Job Rapido and Twitter.

*PPC = pay per click. The advert will be live for a maximum 28 days but can finish earlier. 


Additionally to the advert package options above; we also offer add-on services; Managed advert & CV Database Search. 

Managed Advert:

1x Managed Advert Add-on = £299 +VAT 

3x Managed Advert Add-on = £799 +VAT 


Our Managed advert service is extremely popular and really does help to bring good candidates to interview. 

-              Before the advert is placed live, we will have a strategy conversation including our Managed advert Resourcer; to establish exactly the type of candidate you wish to recruit. 

-              We will then view, filter and contact any shortlisted candidates on your behalf. 

-              When speaking with shortlisted candidates, our main aim is to engage with them, establish that the information in their CV is correct and confirm their interest in your position. 

•             The above sounds easy and obvious, but this really is a big challenge. Too often applicants apply for positions and then are not readily available when contacted. Our resourcing team are able to call, text and email on multiple occasions – often increasing the likelihood that the shortlisted candidate will arrive at interview. 

-              Once we have spoken with and vetted the candidate, we will then be quick to speak with you regarding the applicant. We will express our reasoning for why we think they are suitable for the position, and if you agree, we will arrange your interview for you. 

-              We look to do this for up to 3 interviews per role before seeking feedback from the interviews. If after the feedback, you still require more candidates, we will then look to arrange another 3 interviews (candidates depending). 


Just to quickly stress, you do not need to add the above Managed service to your advert. 

This is an optional additional service for you to consider 


CV Database Search:

1x CV Database Search = £199 +VAT

3x CV Database Searches = £499 +VAT 


Our CV Database search allows us to actively seek candidates who have recently been on the job platforms looking for new positions. 

-              We can search these platforms off location and by using key words. 

-              For example, if you are looking to recruit for an Administrator, we can search for candidates who have Administrator or Administration in their CV; in Canterbury. 

-              These candidates will have been actively looking for new positions within the last 3 months. 

-              Once confirmed, we will then send you the CVs to consider before contacting. 

-              If they are looking for new roles, brilliant! Suggest your position and you should hopefully be able to arrange an interview. 


Again, you do not need to add the CV Database search to your package. This again is an optional extra. 



Sorry for the excessive information above. 

I wanted to make sure you have all options to consider. 


I’m fully aware how important cost is for your Charity.

With that in mind, if you decide you would like to try our Managed advert service, then I can offer a Free CV Database search for you with this purchase. 

If you opt to purchase 3x (or more Managed adverts), I will include the CV Database search for Free with all of these credits. 



I really hope this email finds you well and that you have the information you require. 


Please don’t hesitate to call or email with any questions or preferences you might have. 

I look forward to hearing from you again soon. 

Kind Regards

Candidates overseas
People not turning up to interviews
People expecting higher salaries etc.

Hello Heidi,

I feel the same, I was hoping for a better response. The ad has been published correctly.

I have looked at all of the care roles we have posted in the last month, and many clients are in the same position. 
Genuinely- some months do run better than others.

 
 

There are quite a few factors that come into conversion to application:
Views- This is down to how many candidates happen to be looking for this type of role, in your location
Application- Candidates will have a desired location, hours, rate of pay

Total Jobs alone has received 42 views:

 

•	As an industry, a lot of care staff are re-training so there aren’t as many candidates in the market.
•	The double jab rule is coming into play so a lot of staff are under threat of dismissal, and care homes are trying to retain staff that are fully vaccinated to avoid having to recruit, this may involve wage increases.
•	Another consideration would be how heavily populated Gloucester is, what percentage of those are care staff (are there many care homes in the area?) and what percentage are looking to change job roles.
•	You have tried us on our basic standard package- the Premium and Branded Packages will get a greater response as you get more exposure, quite a lot of candidates like to know who they are applying to work for before hitting the apply button i) Do not want to apply for current employer ii)May have worked somewhere prior and not wish to return iii) Knowledge of who they are applying for, commute, etc.
•	Quite a lot of my care clients post adverts for consecutive months as they recruit large volumes of staff, and this can take 0-6 weeks to complete the necessary processes of application, forms, checks, notice periods, training, etc.

Hi Susy

I have just tried to call but there was no answer.

Following on from the last adverts I think it would be really useful to go through and discuss how the campaign went overall.

Overall it is a very different market to what it was 12 months ago, with their being fewer candidates available and actively searching.

When we post an advert it is really important that we make it stand out and to be as attractive as possible in order to generate as many quality candidates as possible.

I do feel that with the salaries on your two vacancy adverts being hidden, it put candidates off as when they are searching for these types of roles- if there are other adverts with salary advertised it will look more attractive. Typically speaking, the more highly skilled professionals will generally want to know who they are applying to work for- a branded advert can help really with this.


The premium option selected did include over 100 job boards with 4 of the UK Largest job boards (sponsored) included- and the content of the adverts was good.
Sometimes it can take more than 1 month to generate CVs- some of clients post over consecutive months for this reason.

Who They Are

Apex Timber Buildings Ltd is a manufacturer of bespoke timber structures including:

Garden rooms & offices

Workshops

Sheds & storage units

Timber garages

Bespoke timber buildings

They offer design, manufacture, delivery, and full installation, meaning they run factory operations + on-site fitting teams.

Headquarters: Wareham, Dorset (South West).

They have a very strong local reputation in the bespoke timber building market, especially for high-quality, hand-built timber structures.

2️⃣ What Their Business Model Tells Us (Hiring Pressure Points)
A. Factory + Site Install Teams = Labour Intensity

They require:

Timber frame fabricators

Carpentry-skilled operatives

Machine operatives (saws, joinery machinery)

Fitters/Installers

Labourers

Delivery/driving staff

This creates constant staffing pressure.

B. Seasonal Demand Spikes

Timber building companies peak in:

Spring

Summer

Early Autumn

Seasonal surges = they need temporary labour, installers, and workshop operatives quickly.

C. Lead Time & Customer Wait Lists

Key signs they have more work than labour:

Their industry typically books months ahead

Bespoke manufacturing increases bottlenecks

Client deadlines become stressful when short-staffed

Meaning: labour gaps = lost revenue — a major recruitment pain point.

D. Skilled Labour Shortage (Carpentry/Joinery)

South West England has:

A shortage of time-served carpenters

High competition from construction firms

Limited workforce mobility

This makes Apex Timber Buildings an ideal client for a recruiter who can source skilled hands the local market can’t provide through adverts alone.

3️⃣ Why They’re a Strong Recruitment Prospect

✔️ Factory work + installation work = constant churn
✔️ Carpentry / joinery talent is scarce — they struggle via Indeed/Gumtree
✔️ Seasonal spikes require flexible staffing
✔️ Small family-run business = little/no in-house recruitment capability
✔️ Growth of garden office market means consistent hiring pressure
✔️ Skilled trade environment = they benefit from pre-vetting & quality candidates

This combination makes them high-value, high-probability recruitment clients.

4️⃣ Roles You Can Realistically Place With Them

You have lots of entry points:

Workshop / Factory

Timber Fabricators

Joiners / Carpenters

Machine Operatives

Production Operatives

Bench Joiners

Site Work

Installers / Fitters

Cladding Fitters

Labourers

Drivers/Delivery Crew

Team Leaders

Office

Estimators

Project Coordinators

Admin / Scheduling

They’re a company that would likely start with operatives/installers, then expand into admin/project staff once trust is built.

Hi [Name],

I’m reaching out from Talent Finder Recruitment because we specialise in supplying high-quality staff across residential care, supported living, and children’s services — and I noticed Omega Care Group/Omega Life is actively recruiting for roles such as Support Worker, Waking Night, and Team Leader.

Residential children’s services (EBD/SEMH)

Safeguarding, behaviour support & de-escalation

Waking night and 24-hour rota work

Leaving-care pathway support

Level 3 Children & Young People’s Workforce (or working toward it)

Our model is simple: a fixed fee, no percentages, no hidden charges, giving you cost certainty while allowing us to deliver pre-screened candidates within 48 hours.

If you’re still hiring, I’d welcome a quick call to show how we can support immediately.

James

Best,
{{YourName}}

Subject: Reducing time-to-hire for care roles

Hi {{FirstName}},

Many providers we support are finding recruitment challenging due to time pressures and compliance checks.

Full pre-screening & right-to-work checks

Qualification and reference verification

Fast turnaround shortlists

This allows teams to focus on interviews only.

Would it be useful to explore this further?

Kind regards,
{{YourName}}

Subject: Supporting care teams with ready staff

Hi {{FirstName}},

We’re currently supporting several care providers who needed quick, compliant staffing solutions for both short- and long-term needs.

Feedback has been positive due to:

Quality over volume

Candidates aligned with CQC expectations

Faster onboarding

If this is relevant to your current plans, I’d be glad to connect.

Best,
{{YourName}}

Subject: Is recruitment a priority right now?

Hi {{FirstName}},

I appreciate things can get busy, so just checking whether recruitment is something you’re focusing on at the moment.

If not, I’m happy to reconnect at a better time.

Kind regards,
{{YourName}}

Best,
{{YourName}}

Subject: Example candidate profile available

3–7+ years care experience

Dementia & complex needs exposure

Immediate availability or short notice

I can share anonymised profiles if helpful.

Let me know.

Kind regards,
{{YourName}}

Subject: Workforce planning for the coming months

Hi {{FirstName}},

Even if you’re not actively hiring today, many organisations are planning ahead for:

Holiday cover

Increased demand

Staff turnover

We can pipeline candidates in advance to avoid last-minute pressure.

Open to a brief conversation?

Best,
{{YourName}}

Hi {{FirstName}},

Just checking back in as I haven’t heard back yet.

If recruitment isn’t a priority right now, no problem at all — just let me know and I won’t keep chasing.

Kind regards,
{{YourName}}

Subject: Should I close the loop?

Hi {{FirstName}},

I don’t want to clutter your inbox.

If this isn’t relevant right now, just let me know and I’ll step back.
If it is worth a quick chat, I’m happy to make myself available.

Best,
{{YourName}}

Hi {{FirstName}},

Before I pause outreach, I wanted to make one final check.

We still have strong care candidates available and would welcome supporting you if the need arises.

Kind regards,
{{YourName}}

I’ll close the loop for now, but please feel free to reach out if recruitment support is needed in the future.

Wishing you all the best.

Kind regards,
{{YourName}}

Who Are ALUFAST?

ALUFAST (formally Alufast Ltd) is a specialist aluminium fabrication company based in Basildon, Essex.

Core services include:

Aluminium windows

Aluminium doors

Curtain walling

Shopfronts

Facades & architectural glazing systems

Powder coating

Fabrication & installation

Their customers are mainly:

Commercial contractors

Developers

Shopfitting contractors

Architectural firms

Building companies requiring bespoke aluminium/glazing systems

They promote themselves as a fast-turnaround manufacturer, meaning speed is a strong selling point and staffing constraints hit operations hard.

Company info:

Active limited company, established 2013.

Registered office: Basildon, Essex.

Industry SIC: Manufacture of metal doors and windows.

2️⃣ What This Reveals (Recruitment Opportunities)

Here are the trigger points showing ALUFAST is a good recruitment prospect.

???? A. Fabrication Companies ALWAYS Need Skilled Labour

Aluminium fabrication shops commonly struggle to hire:

Fabricators

Aluminium welders

Bench joiners (aluminium profiles)

Machine operators (saws, CNC, punch tools)

Fitters / installers

Site fix teams (CSCS)

ALUFAST operate in exactly this high-shortage labour sector.

➡️ Recruitment Angle:
“These are shortage occupations. We can build you a pipeline of fabricators and installers who already know aluminium systems like Reynaers, Smart Systems, Schueco, AluK etc.”

???? B. High Demand + Fast Turnaround = Staffing Pressure

They position themselves on:

Fast delivery

Quick turnaround

Rapid installation

When fabrication businesses promise speed, any drop in staff numbers kills their USP.

➡️ Recruitment Angle:
“We help you prevent production delays by maintaining a reliable supply of fabricators, CNC operators and installers ready to go.”

???? C. Project-Based Work = Peaks & Troughs

Their clients are often shopfitters, developers, and main contractors — which means:

Multiple jobs running at once

Some weeks overloaded

Some weeks quiet

Install teams must be available on short notice

➡️ Recruitment Angle:
“You get flexibility — temps for installation peaks, perms for long-term capacity.”

???? D. Installer Shortages Across the UK

Aluminium window/door installers are one of the hardest trades to recruit for.

CSCS required

Experience with structural openings

Must understand glazing, handling, sealing, fixing

➡️ Recruitment Angle:
“You get vetted installers with the right tools, CSCS paperwork, PPE and site-ready attitude.”

???? E. Likely No Internal HR Team

Fabrication SMEs rarely have internal HR — usually the owner, ops manager or factory manager is doing recruitment on the side.

This creates:

Slow hiring

Lost time sifting CVs

Poor quality applicants

Hiring done reactively, not proactively

➡️ Recruitment Angle:
“As your account manager, we take recruitment off your hands so your production & installation teams stay focused.”

3️⃣ Roles You Can Realistically Help Them With
Immediate / frequent roles:

Aluminium Fabricators

CNC/Router Operators

Window & Door Installers

Curtain Wall Installers

Shopfront Fitters

Project Coordinators

Estimators

Factory Supervisors

Production Operatives

Occasional but valuable roles:

AutoCAD Technicians

Health & Safety

Transport / Delivery roles

Office/Admin

Why Apex Mechanical is a Good Prospect for Recruitment Services — Key Trigger Points & Opportunity Signals

Here are the main reasons I see Apex Mechanical Ltd as a strong potential client for your agency services:

???? 1. Skilled trades + technical staff demand (welders, HVAC, pipework, engineers)

Their work requires qualified welders, mechanical fitters, pipework fabricators, HVAC/steam/oil system installers — not generic labour. Those are harder-to-find, niche skill sets especially with certification requirements (welding standards, possibly Gas Safety, risk-assessed works).
Recruitment value: you can deliver pre-qualified, certified tradespeople ready for complex mechanical/pipework jobs — many companies struggle to find those via standard job ads.

???? 2. Mix of workshop fabrication + site installations → need for diverse staffing

Because they both prefabricate in workshop and carry out on-site installations / maintenance, they likely need a mix of:

Workshop fabricators / welders

On-site pipework/mechanical installers / HVAC engineers

Site welders / mechanical fitters

Possibly logistics or site-crew staff for transport/delivery of prefabricated modules

Recruitment value: this variety works well for an agency with capacity to source across disciplines — you’re not limited to one “type” of vacancy.

???? 3. Project-based & contract-based workload → cyclical staffing pressure

Mechanical contractors typically have peaks and troughs: project wins, maintenance contracts, new builds, shutdown works, reactive maintenance, etc. This can lead to unpredictable demand for staff.
Recruitment value: your agency can act as a flexible staffing partner — be ready with skilled tradespeople when demand spikes, reducing their lead time and risk of missing deadlines.

???? 4. Company is active and recently updated filings — possible growth or restructure

Recent address change (2025) and up-to-date filings suggest company is stable, possibly growing or restructuring to handle more work. That often coincides with upcoming staffing needs.
Recruitment value: good time to approach — they may anticipate expansion, new contracts or need fresh resource.

???? 5. Niche technical skills + compliance requirements make hiring internally difficult

Given the specialised nature of their work (pressurised systems, gas/oil/steam/chilled water, welded joints, safety standards), hiring in-house and managing compliance, certification, testing, and risk assessments is a burden.
Recruitment value: you can provide pre-screened, safety-compliant, certified candidates — reducing their risk, overhead, and administrative burden.

???? 6. Potential for long-term relationships — repeat placements

Because their demand is likely recurrent (ongoing maintenance contracts, new builds, reactive works), a recruitment partner could become a long-term supplier of labour, giving you repeated business rather than ad-hoc placements.

???? Roles & Hire Types You Could Offer Them

Given their business model and needs, the most relevant roles to pitch are:

Welders / Pipework Fabricators (workshop-based)

Mechanical Installers / HVAC Engineers / Pipework Fitters (site-based)

Plumbers or Steam/Oil system engineers (depending on project type)

Site crew / Pipework installation assistants

Maintenance engineers (for reactive and contract maintenance)

Possibly multi-skilled mechanical fitters (for varying systems: water, gas, steam, chilled)

Temporary/contract staff for project spikes or shutdowns

If you support certification and compliance screening, even better — those trades require correct welding codes, safety training, possibly gas/fuel certification.

Hi Vanessa,

Thank you for the update.

I appreciate that recruitment can be time consuming, the flagging system in clicking green, blue or red is usually very useful and utilised as you review each CV via the ATS.

In our experience it can take up to 3 phone calls to reach candidates- 39 applicants could be potentially 117 phone calls.
It is very unusual to not have filled at least 1 vacancy from this many CVs.

That being said, some of my similar clients that recruit very regularly on an ongoing basis run 2,3 month campaigns rather that just 1 for 28 days.
There is a discount for multiple adverts.

We did recommend a Branded advert- as this can generate up to 30% greater a response, including your logo on the advert and your name within the advert (rather than or agency logo and ‘our client’. Glassdoor

From that, you can infer their core hiring buckets:

IT Field Engineers / Service Engineers

On-site client visits, travel heavy, early starts/late finishes.

Workshop / IT/AV Engineers

Bench repairs, configuration, testing, kit prep.

Helpdesk / Remote Support Analysts

Likely exist even if not advertised – managed IT = support desk.

Junior Office / Admin / Office Support

Office Junior shows they bring in entry-level support.

Possibly Developers / Software Engineers

As they advertise software creation & dev as a service. 
europages.co.uk
+1

These are exactly the kind of roles that:

Are hard to fill locally (Letchworth/Baldock isn’t central London).

Require a blend of customer service + technical ability.

Often have high churn due to travel, out-of-hours work, and better salaries at big MSPs.

4. Recruitment pain points & trigger signals

Here’s where you can really sound like you “get it”:

A. 365-day IT service = rota and burnout risk

They promote exceptional service “365 days a year”, and field engineer reviews mention long days & travel. 
instagram.com
+1

Likely pain:

Covering sickness/holidays on a small team.

Engineers stretched between long drives and reactive calls.

Difficulty finding people who are okay with that lifestyle long-term.

B. Small headcount + growth = each hire really matters

With 20–49 employees, each engineer or admin is a big percentage of the workforce. 
Kompass
+1

Likely pain:

A single bad hire hurts culture and service levels.

Directors don’t have time to sift loads of CVs or run multi-stage processes.

C. IT services + software = mixed skill demand

They sell both IT support and software development. 
amcofm.co.uk
+1

Likely pain:

Needing technically diverse talent: some purely IT support, some hybrid IT/AV, some dev.

Struggle to attract good developers to Baldock/Letchworth vs big-city employers.

D. Owner-led & customer-facing – reputational risk

As a long-standing service provider, every engineer is “the brand” on-site or on the phone.

Likely pain:

They care more about attitude, communication and reliability than a CV full of buzzwords.

Recruitment that doesn’t screen for soft skills will have burnt them before.

5. Where you (Talent Finder) can add value

Given you’re their account manager and they’ve used Talent Finder before, your pitch is:

Not “Hi, we’re an agency” – they already know you.

It’s: “Let’s actually tailor how we use Talent Finder to your real roles and pressure points.”

You’re in a good position to help them with:

Targeted campaigns for IT Field Engineers & Workshop Engineers.

Building an ongoing pipeline of junior talent (Office Juniors, Trainee/Junior IT Support) in the SG6 / SG7 corridor.

Potential developer searches when they want to push the software side.

And you frame all of that via a feasibility assessment – a short meeting to map their likely hiring over the next 6–12 months and shape campaigns around that.

A recruitment agency will charge you two lots of commission for a temp role- 
-	There would be an initial commission on the hourly rate: Example Rate of Pay £12.00 per hour – agency may charge you £15.00 per hour (£3.00 commission per hour x 40= £120 per month x 12 weeks (3 months) £1,440)
-	At the end of the 3 months (usually Minimum timescale before making perm) you would then decided whether to offer the permanent role- if you did then there would be a placement fee. 
The average fee is typically between 10-20% of the salary- going rate I have come across recently is 12.5%: Example £20,000 x 12.5% = £2,500

What you have been told is correct, the recruitment agencies probably don’t have good quality letting candidates on their ‘books’ at the moment for temporary work- this means they will either try and place a candidate who has the capacity to be trained in that role OR more likely they will need to advertise the role and then register the candidates, and then arrange interviews with you good selves. I can assure you that a lot of the best candidates are already employed and have limited availability, so the timescale to work with an agency in this way is doubled- that’s not to mention the much higher commissions you will need to pay. You will not get the same response if advertising a temp to perm as it looks like more of a risk, and is presented as an hourly rate initially which is not as attractive.

A recruitment agency will charge you two lots of commission for a temp role- 
-	There would be an initial commission on the hourly rate: Example Rate of Pay £12.00 per hour – agency may charge you £15.00 per hour (£3.00 commission per hour x 40= £120 per month x 12 weeks (3 months) £1,440)
-	At the end of the 3 months (usually Minimum timescale before making perm) you would then decided whether to offer the permanent role- if you did then there would be a placement fee. 
The average fee is typically between 10-20% of the salary- going rate I have come across recently is 12.5%: Example £20,000 x 12.5% = £2,500

What you have been told is correct, the recruitment agencies probably don’t have good quality letting candidates on their ‘books’ at the moment for temporary work- this means they will either try and place a candidate who has the capacity to be trained in that role OR more likely they will need to advertise the role and then register the candidates, and then arrange interviews with you good selves. I can assure you that a lot of the best candidates are already employed and have limited availability, so the timescale to work with an agency in this way is doubled- that’s not to mention the much higher commissions you will need to pay. We Write Your Job Advert

Hi Nichola,

Thank you for taking the time to speak with me this afternoon, it was lovely talking with you.
As discussed, this is just a quick email so we have an open communication channel should you require our services in the near future. 

We really appreciate your feedback regarding number and quality of candidates that applied for your vacant positions previously. 

We are definitely seeing an improvement in the candidate market, but our big recommendation with any advert at the moment is how quickly you can act to invite good candidates to interview. 
There are good candidates applying with experience, but the competition to recruit is extremely strong. 
Receiving an application and engaging with that candidate straight away is a must to avoid losing out to another company. 

With the above being said, and to remind you, we are a low-cost flat fee recruitment agency. We never charge commission and there are no additional fees. 

Please don’t be to put off by the responses you have received so far. 
We advertise your role on 13+ job boards for 28 days and our adverts often get really good applications from candidates with previous experience. 

We would really like to work with you again going forward, so do let me know your requirements/specifications as and when and we can start working our magic.

All the best in the meantime!

Kind regards,

Hi Lesley,

Thank you for taking the time to speak with me this morning.
As discussed, this is just a quick email so we have an open communication channel for as/when you require our services.

Light Source UK used our services for advertising a couple of vacancies in 2020, receiving a very positive response for each advert posted.

(See below: Left hand column indicates – CVs Viewed/Number of Applicants)
 

For your reference, I’ve included our essential information below:

Job Board Options:

Standard – Total Jobs, Jobsite, CareerJet, Adzuna, Job Rapido, Job Flurry, Trovit, Glassdoor, Find-a-Job, Indeed, Reed Premium
                     +100 Micro Job Boards/aggregators   + Social Media Job Boards

Premium – [All of the above+] Indeed Sponsored, CV Library, Linked-In Sponsored Advert, 
                     +up to 2000 aggregators, Niche/Industry specific job boards, Location specific job boards

FULLY BRANDED ADVERT –

We use fully branded premium adverts and will advertise your vacancy across all the job boards above.
This advert is 100% about you, featuring your logo - and nothing about us. Branded ads also enable you to maximise your employer profile in your industry

Our Service: 

•	We specialise in flat-fee recruitment and we never charge commission. 
•	Our service breaks down across two main areas. Optimising / Designing your advert and exposing your role on 12/13+ of the UK’s biggest job boards in order to attract the very best candidates. 
•	Our adverts run for a full 28 days and you receive full access to our Applicant Tracking Software (Portal) to view, filter and respond to candidates. 
•	We offer 3 packages to decide between. These packages differ in levels of exposure your advert receives; Standard, Premium or Branded. 
               The pricing ranges from £299 +VAT, £399 +VAT and £499 +VAT. 
•	You will receive a dedicated Account Manager to help throughout your campaign. We are on hand to offer advice and guidance throughout. 


We are really keen to work with you going forward, so do let me know your requirements when you are ready and we can start working our magic.

I hope this is helpful for you and I look forward to hearing any thoughts you might have. 

Kind regards,
